programs.title: American Pickers
programs.desc: Time has stood still on a sprawling dairy farm, and after a slow start the picking is fast and furious. Down the road, the guys pick one of the biggest barns they've ever seen.

programs.title: Pawn Stars
programs.desc: Get ready for a treasure hunt at the pawn shop when Rick and his team get their hands on items that may be as old as time. Can they make history by buying these rare relics?

programs.title: Outback Truckers
programs.desc: Mark Cromwell heads off the grid, delivering a switchroom to a remote gold mine. Brutal weather and winding roads give Jeff Elliot a stressful sprint to markets in Melbourne. Paul McKie takes on remote Cape York.

programs.title: Deadliest Roads
programs.desc: The rookie team of Tino Rodriguez and Tim Zickuhr haul barrels of gasoline over roads wired with dynamite, and Tim's ready to challenge local police to get the job done.

programs.title: Ax Men
programs.desc: Thanksgiving is over, but the return to work brings more trouble for the Ax Men. The Gustafson crew now faces a nearly impossible deadline after returning from a devastating two-week layoff.  Pig Farm is close to its deadline, but half of the Pihl crew skips work, leaving greenhorn Cody to pick up the slack. Mistakes and inexperience at Stump Branch put profits and lives at risk. Jay Browning makes a troubling discovery about his next job.

programs.title: Mark Berg's Fishing Addiction
programs.sub_title: Great Barrier Island, New Zealand with Darren
programs.desc: Fishing expert Mark Berg visits some of the best fishing destinations around. Chasing a wide variety of fish, Mark is always hoping to capture a new species or develop a new technique.
